title: Camiling Smooth okra: Characteristics
metaDescription: Camiling Smooth okra is an okra variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Camiling Smooth is an okra variety, also sold or known as Condor Camiling Smooth. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Camiling Smooth okra is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Condor Camiling Smooth, this is the same okra. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [okra variety finder](/crop-varieties/okra), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit okra fields most often: [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew), [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest 40 to 45 days after sowing.
**Season:** The sheet calls it an all year variety but lists dry season under adaptability.
Prolific, bearing at nearly every node.
Vigorous, with a long harvest period.
Intermediate resistance to pests and diseases (seller's claim, none named).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: allied Botanical's okra, only the seller's page names it, though a Sariaya, Quezon okra grower told Agriculture Monthly that Condor okra seed suits the rainy season. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual okra on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Camiling Smooth okra

Buyers want smooth, dark green pods picked young. Pick a variety that stays tender a day longer on the plant, because okra turns woody fast in the heat. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Condor Camiling Smooth the same as Camiling Smooth?
items.a: Yes. Condor Camiling Smooth is another name for Camiling Smooth. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Camiling Smooth?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
